named_checks: input_pins
Check all nine exact file bytes/SHA before interpretation; no discovery, alias or alternative path.
receipt_schema
Require physical bigsmall.r214.actual-tool-return.v1, round R214, exact key transport_command; never request actual_command or synthesize alias.
actual_completion
Require actual_tool_return.exit_code=0/chunk87810e, initial deep-equals actual_tool_return, completion=null, attempt=1/retry=0/product_execution=false; independent streams remain null.
transport_exact

Require receipt.transport_command == R214 plan.execution.new_metadata_read.exact_transport_command; receipt.cwd matches plan cwd, shell=/bin/bash/login=false. Verify planned argv/source/finite_env against that transport using shlex.split and exact tokens, never execute it.
complete_output

Require physical actual_tool_return.output is a string without truncation prefix, UTF-8 length equals step.actual_combined_output_utf8_bytes=15116 and <=36000. Parse only this intact physically saved JSON string, not a rendered tool response.
packet_schema

Require exact packet keys reference_count/line_count/references/product_execution; values4/365/list4/false. Require each reference exact path/bytes/sha256/sections and each section exact start/end/text.
reference_identity
Require four reference entries in exact R214 reference_map order with matching byte/SHA identities; current physical bytes/hash and total source line counts equal the original pins.
ranges_and_text

Require section ranges exactly equal corresponding R214 map, seven sections total. Using b.decode('utf-8').splitlines(), compute chr(10).join(str(i+1)+':'+lines[i] for i in range(start-1,end)); compare text UTF-8 bytes exactly. Validate indices before slicing. Do not normalize whitespace or LF.
erratum
Require R215 arithmetic.total=365 and seven end-start+1 counts sum365; preserve R214 historical planned_selected_lines=465. No plan rewrite.
step_consistency

Require step round/chunk/exit, receipt pin, four reference map pins/ranges/per-file selected counts, selected365, guard_completion=true, attempt1/retry0, metadata_used1/remaining0, zero product commands/source_changed=false and null streams consistent with actual receipt. Do not treat step assertion alone as proof.
display_bound

Build display once with four paths/seven labels and exactly the saved365 numbered source lines, plus full2601B step JSON and compact named-check/pin summary. Exclude duplicate initial, transport/source strings and raw failure output. Before printing require UTF-8<=48000; no slicing/truncation permitted.
output_exclusive

Write complete named result with inputs, individual booleans/details, aggregate all_valid and output bound to new exclusive verification-result.json; never overwrite existing output or R214 artifacts. A failed check must be visible and exit nonzero; it never grants acceptance.
implementation_constraints: Standard library pathlib/json/hashlib/signal/shlex only, no subprocess or dynamic execution.
signal.alarm(120); UTF-8 strict; meaningful named failures rather than compound unlabeled assertion.
No product modules imported or called; four targets are read as bytes only.
Write compact full named-check result before bounded display; actual tool return must be stored immediately before interpretation.
If output bound fails or any new issue occurs, preserve actual evidence and STOP; no retry or alternate read.

new_metadata_verification.transport: ROOT freezes a short env -i invocation with each exact argument safely quoted, shell=/bin/bash login=false. No rerun of original reader.

acceptance.required: All actual named checks pass AND ROOT reads the complete saved365 source/step output. Only then ROOT may native-write exclusive R214 root-acceptance.json linking R216 evidence. T2 RED and final R214 acceptance remain held. Independent R204 writer2 source preparation is already re-authorized by ROOT on the successful Sol87810e read and may continue without waiting for this viewer repair; this grants no new source scope or execution.
acceptance.capture: Save actual numeric exit and original returned tool object; independent stdout/stderr are null unless genuinely captured. If display is truncated, do not assert full read or fabricate missing text.
acceptance.preserve: R211/R213 acceptance and R214/R215 historical files remain unchanged. Parent roles are not modified.

stop: Planner saves plan/observation only, then STOP. ROOT authoring and running the new comparator require the stated independent source gate.
